roles.title: SDLC Manager
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-manager to deliver this task with the appropriate specialists.

roles.title: Product Strategist
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-product to turn this idea into a scoped feature brief.

roles.title: Software Architect
roles.summary: Design boundaries and practical technical choices
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-architecture to design this change around the existing system.

roles.title: UX and Accessibility Specialist
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-ux to improve this flow and its accessible states.

roles.title: React Engineer
roles.summary: Build reliable React components and interactions
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-react to implement this frontend behavior using project conventions.

roles.title: Backend and API Engineer
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-backend to implement this API with its relevant failure cases.

roles.title: Database Engineer
roles.summary: Evolve schemas, queries, and data migrations
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-data to design and verify this data change.

roles.title: Feature Engineer
roles.summary: Deliver features and enhancements end to end
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-feature to implement this enhancement and verify its acceptance criteria.

roles.title: Debugging Specialist
roles.summary: Reproduce failures and fix their root cause
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-debug to investigate and fix this broken behavior.

roles.title: Refactoring Specialist
roles.summary: Clean up code while preserving its behavior
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-refactor to simplify this code without changing its behavior.

roles.title: Test Engineer
roles.summary: Verify behavior with focused regression tests
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-testing to test this change and close meaningful coverage gaps.

roles.title: Security Engineer
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-security to review this change for concrete security risks.

roles.title: Code Reviewer
roles.summary: Find actionable defects in proposed changes
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-review to review this diff and report actionable findings.

roles.title: Performance Engineer
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-performance to measure and improve this slow path.

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
roles.summary: Improve builds, CI, and environment reliability
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-devops to fix this build or delivery pipeline.

roles.title: Release Manager
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-release to assess this release candidate and prepare its rollout.

roles.title: Documentation Specialist
roles.summary: Write accurate developer and user documentation
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-docs to update the documentation for this changed behavior.

roles.title: Product Marketing Strategist
roles.summary: Create positioning, launch copy, and experiments
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-marketing to prepare evidence-based positioning and launch copy.

roles.title: Incident and Reliability Engineer
roles.summary: Diagnose incidents and support safe recovery
roles.prompt: Use $sdlc-incident to assess this failure and identify the next recovery step.
